name: The Undeclared War
description: In the post-pandemic world of 2024 during an upcoming British general election involving the UK’s first Black Conservative prime minister, a leading team of analysts at the heart of the UK’s NSA-style spy agency GCHQ attempt to ward off a cyber-attack on the country’s electoral system.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: A young intern's first day at GCHQ coincides with a major cyberattack on the UK. To win her superiors' trust, she breaks ranks to analyse the malware code without permission and uncovers a greater threat missed by others.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Saara befriends John, a veteran GCHQ staffer, and seeks help from Gabriel in decrypting a message in the virus. Danny signs off on Saara attending a cyber conference with US agent Kathy, aware that Russian intelligence will also be there.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Vadim returns to Russia where his allegiances are tested, leading him to a risky stunt.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: With Saara in a difficult position, a revelation forces her hand. Marina moves to London.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Signs of irregularity in the UK general election result prompt political unrest, and the nation's relationship with its allies is threatened. Saara makes a devastating discovery.

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: As the true extent of Russia's interference with the UK becomes clear, Saara and her former classmate join forces. Can they uncover the hidden code and prevent a war?

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: At GCHQ, Danny's under pressure dealing with the fallout from the Russian cyber-attack when a bold new threat emerges.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Vadim finds himself working in captivity for the Chinese. At GCHQ, Danny and Roz clash over China, and the mole hunt continues...

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: When Barbara's charming ex-boyfriend, Nicky Chan, re-appears in her life, she is forced to make an impossible decision.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: While Danny becomes increasingly concerned about Barbara's erratic behaviour, malware causes havoc across government departments.
